text: 上海市经济和信息化委员会印发《上海市软件和信息服务业发展“十五五”规划》。其中提到，推动软件产品AI化发展，加快工业制图、工程设计和生产排产等高价值场景的智能化升级，强化软件产品的智能感知、分析、决策与执行能力。促进软件企业智能化技改，支持软件企业广泛使用Coding平台，构建覆盖全流程、全链条的智能化研发生产线，探索将词元（Token）、数据治理、大模型部署及再训练等投入，纳入企业技术改造支持方向。
text_en: The Shanghai Municipal Commission of Economy and Informatization issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Shanghai's Software and Information Services Industry.' It mentions promoting the AI-driven development of software products, accelerating intelligent upgrades in high-value scenarios such as industrial drafting, engineering design, and production scheduling, and strengthening software products' intelligent perception, analysis, decision-making, and execution capabilities. It promotes intelligent technological transformation of software enterprises, supports widespread use of Coding platforms by software enterprises, builds intelligent R&D production lines covering the entire process and full chain, and explores including investments in tokens, data governance, large model deployment, and retraining into the scope of enterprise technological transformation support.
